formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: MoneyKeel/functions/networth-and-performance/performance.ts:685 beginning = measured ?? (ending − pricedGain − contributions + withdrawals) — dividends/interest received are not taken off; Calculation Module code/engines/window-return.ts:93 days = end − start + 1, so MoneyKeel/functions/networth-and-performance/performance.ts:652 years = 366/365 for a 1Y window and MoneyKeel/functions/networth-and-performance/performance.ts:717 annualises it.
formula_checks.governing_decisions: DEC-0237 (a window of a year or less is never annualised); DEC-1669 (yearly rate only for a period longer than a year; never another method — answers the judge's Q1 point 5: Q1's fallback is superseded); DEC-3656 (beginning = today less what each holding gained, less money moved); DEC-0647 (v17 approved — settles the Since chip of the drawing; the judge's point 3 is settled by phone 3 "not a yearly rate"); DEC-3035i (no walk where the record exists but begins late — app complies)
formula_checks.plain_example: 1Y on 2026-10-10, $40,000 → $44,000, nothing moved: before +9.97% "a year" → should be +10.00% for the year. No record, VTI $105,000 up 5% plus a $1,200 dividend kept as cash: before beginning $101,200, change in value $3,800 → should be $100,000 and $5,000.
formula_checks.note: Of the judge's five faults: (1) and (2) are code defects, confirmed by cases; (3) settled by DEC-0647/v17 phone 3; (4) the 7.46%/year in the drawing is the DEC-0643 stand-in rate, itself replaced by DEC-1669 (stale drawing, not a code fault); (5) Q1 superseded by DEC-1669.
